messages.author: ab9c0ce12612a2e4
messages.subject: lavaan to MS-Word
parts:
Is there any way to  convert lavaan output to MS-word using Xtable? If not is there any other way to do that? Although not related to lavaan? is there any way to convert the output of principal method(psych package) to a nice MS-word table. How can I remove the # appended at the beginning of the output? Is there any code available for doing the same? Thanks in advance for your feedback.

P.S: I used RMarkdown and Rstudio to knit to word and HTML. But I do not how to format it in a neat table without the # at the beginning.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan to MS-Word
parts:
According to this document:

https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/rmarkdown-reference.pdf

there is a chunk option called "comment" that you can use to place no characters in the left margin of output (just specify empty quotation marks).  

Terry

messages.subject: Re: lavaan to MS-Word

Hi Terry,

The empty quotation mark did not work. After a bit of googling, I found that,we need to use comment=NA to remove the # from the output.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan to MS-Word
parts:
Good to know, thanks.  

Other than copy/pasting into Word, I don't know about exporting text from the console output, but you could check out the semTools functions called clipboard() and saveFile() to see if they work for you.  You can open *.txt files in Word, so maybe you could even use a *.doc file extension to see if it will open in Word automatically.

Terry
